notes: Chandra's Incinerator (M21): the reduction counts noncombat damage dealt to your opponents THIS TURN. Shock deals 2 to seat 1, then the turn passes to seat 1 and back to seat 0. On the new turn no damage has been dealt, so the Incinerator costs the full {5}{R}: the remaining R1 C5 (this engine's mana pool persists between steps, BACKLOG B-12) pays it exactly and the pool ends empty; a stale reduction of 2 would leave 2 mana. Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
